'''Barnley''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] native of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and member of the [[Human League]]. He was much larger and more rotund than the Human average.

==Biography==
Before the onset of the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]], he and fellow [[Human League]] member [[Flautis]] captured [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], after recognizing his physical simiarity to their leader [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]]. They later released him on the orders of the Sal-Solo, the [[Hidden Leader]].<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" />
